requirements.title: Omitted ROUND= default shall be one of the listed modes
requirements.definition: The processor-dependent omitted ROUND= mode shall be one of the listed modes.

pending.round-default-one-of-listed-modes: Concrete INQUIRE plan: OPEN a named file with FORM='FORMATTED' while omitting ROUND=, prefill a default-character ROUND inquiry variable with a nonmatching sentinel such as '#################', then INQUIRE by unit with ROUND=. Per 12.10.2.28, ROUND= is assigned UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST, COMPATIBLE, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED corresponding to the rounding mode in effect for a formatted connection, and PROCESSOR_DEFINED is returned only if the behavior differs from the five named modes. Because 12.5.6.17 makes the omitted ROUND= mode processor dependent but requires it to be one of the listed modes, assert membership in exactly that six-token set, not which token the processor chose.

review_rationale: Source registration for the OPEN statement and its specifiers, 12.5.6.1-12.5.6.19 (batch151). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds. Round 1 found required OPEN defaults with only generic plans and required default tokens over-suppressed as unobservable; both are now concrete sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans (ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and ROUND as set membership). Rounds 2 and 3 found that INQUIRE(POSITION=) reports connection STATE, not the omitted OPEN token, and that a re-OPEN plan observes 12.5.6.1 p6 rather than the POSITION default; the omitted POSITION= token is now recorded as not portably observable, as are the STATUS and ENCODING default tokens. The eight numbered rules R1204-R1207 and C1203-C1206 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
